original_test_intent: Read the BMC's Remote Virtual Media capability and current state through Redfish and verify the described values match the platform specification.
original_method: Discover the Manager's advertised VirtualMedia collection, enumerate and validate its members, capture only approved capability/state properties and compare them against a firmware-matched expected matrix without invoking a media action.
manual_activity: Provide the firmware-matched VirtualMedia collection/member contract and expected per-member capability/state matrix, including SupportedMedia, Inserted, ConnectedVia and any image/name fields permitted in retained evidence.
required_inputs: Advertised Manager and VirtualMedia collection/member URIs
safety_requirements: Do not assume `.VirtualMedia` exists on the collection response
No hardcoded credentials or TLS bypass
Never call InsertMedia, EjectMedia, Connect, Disconnect or OEM media actions
Do not mount, expose, boot or install an image
Redact credentials, URLs, share paths and usernames
Fail closed on unexpected member identity or schema
agent_execution_scope: Discover the Manager and VirtualMedia links
Use secret-backed read-only access over verified TLS
Capture status and complete redacted responses
Compare per-member supported media and current state
Report absent, extra or ambiguous members/properties
Confirm no action request or state change
engineer_actions: Provide endpoint/schema and expected member matrix
Approve the capability/state property set and redaction policy
Confirm that this row excludes media insertion, mount, boot and installation

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET targets the relevant concept, but hardcodes ManagerId, disables TLS verification, assumes a collection property named `.VirtualMedia`, omits member traversal and has no expected matrix; therefore it cannot establish the criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Follow advertised Manager and VirtualMedia links, securely GET the collection and each validated member, retain complete redacted responses and compare only the approved capability/state properties with the versioned oracle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Remote Vmedia read-only scope and 15/10 timing remain; endpoint, member set, property matrix, expected values and sensitive-field policy are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use collection-aware Redfish discovery and schema validation, then perform a deterministic per-member capability/state comparison with sensitive metadata redaction.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces the placeholder and unsupported unconditional YES with advertised-link traversal, an external oracle, complete status/member evidence and a strict no-media-action boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates advertised remote-media inventory and current read-only state only; it does not prove that an image can be inserted, mounted, booted or used for installation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct collection can still hide a missing member or unsupported media type; current Inserted/ConnectedVia/Image state may also expose operational or sensitive management information.

project_override_considerations: If the firmware uses OEM VirtualMedia members or properties, preserve standard Redfish evidence and apply only the supplied firmware-specific mapping. Do not reinterpret this row as authorization to manipulate virtual media.
expected_evidence: Advertised VirtualMedia collection and member URIs
HTTP status and complete redacted collection/member response hashes
Per-member identity, SupportedMedia and approved state fields
No media action, host-storage change or log clear

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, generic read-only Procedure and specification-match Criteria consistently describe inspection rather than media manipulation. The placeholder and missing expected matrix are incompleteness, not a competing operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The endpoint/schema, expected capability/state matrix and redaction rules are identifiable package inputs, so the case is REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Reclassifies a non-verifying placeholder query into a collection-aware comparison that cannot mistake collection metadata for member capability, leak media details or silently cross into media manipulation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Redfish VirtualMedia URI may identify a collection whose Members point to individual CD/DVD or USB-like resources; filtering the collection with `.VirtualMedia` is not evidence that each member was retrieved or validated. Capability fields such as MediaTypesSupported must be distinguished from transient state such as Inserted, ConnectedVia and Image. Because changing those states can expose remote content to the host and affect boot behavior, this record permits bounded GETs only. Read-only evidence can still disclose image URLs and share identities, so redaction is part of correctness rather than an optional logging preference.
